claim.claim-text: 1. A method performed by a terminal (116) in a wireless communication system, the method comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one first signal comprises at least one of a channel state information reference signal, CSI-RS, or a synchronization signal and physical broadcast channel, SS/PBCH, block.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the multiple SINR values comprises a largest of the SINR value and differential SINR values relative to the largest SINR.
4. The method of claim 3,

wherein a bitwidth of the largest SINR value and a bitwidth of the differential SINR values are different, and wherein the largest SINR value is quantized to a 7-bit value with half a dB step size and the differential SINR values are quantized to a 4-bit value with one dB step size.
5. A method performed by a base station (102) in a wireless communication system, the method comprising:

providing, to a terminal (116), first configuration information on a first resource set of at least one first signal for channel measurement and second configuration information on a second resource set of at least one second signal for interference measurement; transmitting, to the terminal (116), the at least one first signal for channel measurement and the at least one second signal for interference measurement, according to the first resource set and the second resource set; and receiving, from the terminal (116), multiple signal-to-interference and noise ratio, SINR, values measured based on the at least one first signal and the at least one second signal and multiple resource indicators related to the at least one first signal, wherein the multiple resource indicators correspond respectively to the multiple SINR values, and wherein each resource in the first resource set is associated with one resource in the second resource set.

6. The method of claim 5, wherein the at least one first signal comprises at least one of a channel state information reference signal, CSI-RS, or a synchronization signal and physical broadcast channel, SS/PBCH, block.
7. The method of claim 5, wherein the multiple SINR values comprises a largest of the SINR value and differential SINR values relative to the largest SINR.
8. The method of claim 7,

wherein a bitwidth of the largest SINR value and a bitwidth of the differential SINR values are different, and wherein the largest SINR value is quantized to a 7-bit value with half a dB step size and the differential SINR values are quantized to a 4-bit value with one dB step size.
9. A terminal (116) in a wireless communication system, the terminal (116) comprising:

a transceiver (310); and a controller (340) configured to: obtain, from a base station (102), first configuration information on a first resource set of at least one first signal for channel measurement and second configuration information on a second resource set of at least one second signal for interference measurement, receive, from the base station (102) via the transceiver (310), the at least one first signal for channel measurement and the at least one second signal for interference measurement, based on the first resource set and the second resource set, respectively, measure multiple signal-to-interference and noise ratio, SINR, values based on the received at least one first signal and the received at least one second signal, and transmit, to the base station (102) via the transceiver (310), the multiple SINR values and multiple resource indicators related to the at least one first signal, wherein the multiple resource indicators correspond respectively to the multiple SINR values, and wherein each resource in the first resource set is associated with one resource in the second resource set.

10. The terminal (116) of claim 9, wherein the at least one first signal comprises at least one of a channel state information reference signal, CSI-RS, or a synchronization signal and physical broadcast channel, SS/PBCH, block.
11. The terminal (116) of claim 9, wherein the multiple SINR values comprises a largest of the SINR value and differential SINR values relative to the largest SINR.
12. The terminal (116) of claim 11,

wherein a bitwidth of the largest SINR value and a bitwidth of the differential SINR values are different, and wherein the largest SINR value is quantized to a 7-bit value with half a dB step size and the differential SINR values are quantized to a 4-bit value with one dB step size.
13. A base station (102) in a wireless communication system, the base station (102) comprising:

a transceiver (210); and a controller (225) configured to: provide, to a terminal (116), first configuration information on a first resource set of at least one first signal for channel measurement and second configuration information on a second resource set of at least one second signal for interference measurement, transmit, to the terminal (116) via the transceiver (210), the at least one first signal for channel measurement and the at least one second signal for interference measurement, according to the first resource set and the second resource set, and receive, from the terminal (116) via the transceiver (210), multiple signal-to-interference and noise ratio, SINR, values measured based on the at least one first signal and the at least one second signal and multiple resource indicators related to the at least one first signal, wherein the multiple resource indicators correspond respectively to the multiple SINR values, and wherein each resource in the first resource set is associated with one resource in the second resource set.

14. The base station (102) of claim 13, wherein the at least one first signal comprises at least one of a channel state information reference signal, CSI-RS, or a synchronization signal and physical broadcast channel, SS/PBCH, block.
15. The base station (102) of claim 14,

wherein the multiple SINR values comprises a largest of the SINR value and differential SINR values relative to the largest SINR. wherein a bitwidth of the largest SINR value and a bitwidth of the differential SINR values are different, and wherein the largest SINR value is quantized to a 7-bit value with half a dB step size and the differential SINR values are quantized to a 4-bit value with one dB step size.
